cases.name: etaf-slides-tests-deck-splits-front-matter-and-notes
cases.purpose: Front matter, slide separators and a notes block land in the deck title, the slide list and the current slide's notes.

cases.name: etaf-slides-tests-layout-marks-cover-and-content
cases.purpose: A heading with a subtitle renders as a centered cover, while a heading with a list renders as a titled content slide.

cases.name: etaf-slides-tests-invalid-decks-signal-an-error
cases.purpose: An unreadable deck file and a source without slides fail as slide errors instead of opening an empty presentation.

cases.name: etaf-slides-tests-navigation-clamps-at-the-deck-edges
cases.purpose: Paging or jumping past either end keeps the first or last slide selected instead of wrapping.

cases.name: etaf-slides-tests-theme-cycle-visits-light-dark-and-auto
cases.purpose: The theme key walks light, then dark, then the frame's own appearance and reports the resolved appearance.

cases.name: etaf-slides-tests-stage-keeps-the-aspect-ratio-inside-the-viewport
cases.purpose: The stage stays inside the window's column and row budget at the slide aspect ratio, and reports clipping below the minimum usable size.

cases.name: etaf-slides-tests-overflow-reports-slides-over-budget
cases.purpose: A slide whose estimated content exceeds the stage body is listed as overflow while a short slide is not.

cases.name: etaf-slides-tests-mount-renders-the-current-slide
cases.purpose: A mounted deck shows only the current slide's title and body, and repaints to the next slide when the session moves.

cases.name: etaf-slides-tests-notes-band-follows-the-toggle
cases.purpose: Turning the notes on adds the speaker notes above the footer, and the position line keeps reporting the slide.

cases.name: etaf-slides-tests-application-keys-advance-the-slides
cases.purpose: A deck opens at presentation text size and SPC, DEL and o drive the mounted application through its declared root keys, moving between slides and the overview.
